outline:
本課程旨在介紹供應鏈管理中之相關問題及議題 。其中包含產業分析、e化概念、需求及供應管理、長鞭效應、存貨管理、延遲理論、及供應鏈管理實務。
The purpose of the course is to offer the students the fundamentals to supply chain management, including the most essential topics of strategy, planning, and operations.
schedule:
Week 1. Introduction to the Supply Chain
Week 2. Supply chain performance, drivers and metrics
Week 3. Network design in the Supply Chain
Week 4. Designing global Supply Chains
Week 5. Demand forecasting in a Supply Chain
Week 6. Aggregate planning in a Supply Chain
Week 7. Coordination in a Supply Chain
Week 8. Term project proposal
Week 9. Inventory in a Supply Chain (Managing economies of scale and uncertainty)
Week 10. Determining the optimal level of product availability
Week 11. Transportation in a Supply Chain
Week 12. Sourcing decisions in a Supply Chain
Week 13. Pricing and revenue management in a Supply Chain
Week 14. Information technology in a Supply Chain
Week 15. Sustainability and the Supply Chain
Week 16. Final exam
assessment:
Presentation and participation in learning activities: %20
Term project: %40
Final exam: %40
